title: Sign in
lede: No password: this deployment signs you in with a code sent to your phone number.

phone.title: Your phone number
phone.description: This is who you are to this deployment. Nothing about your groups changes because of it - a group records its own name for you.
phone.label: Phone number

code.title: The code
code.description: Six digits. It is good for five minutes, and a few wrong tries in a row will use it up.
code.label: Code
code.where: A code was sent to {phoneNumber}. This deployment has no SMS provider yet, so look for it in the server log - the line names the number it was for.
